customManagers.description: EXAMPLE - extension under test, pinned as TC_EXTENSION_VERSION in the system-tests workflow. The worked example tests test-data (EXTENSION_NAME), so this tracks the test-data releases, like TC_TEST_DATA_VERSION below. Tracking another extension here makes the workflow download test-data at that extension's version, which does not exist. Replace depNameTemplate with your extension. To pick up SNAPSHOTs from the JFrog Maven repository, use datasource maven with registryUrl https://sbb.jfrog.io/artifactory/polarion-mvn and add a packageRule with ignoreUnstable false for it.
Track the admin-utility extension version pinned in the system-tests workflow (JFrog Maven repo)
Track the test-data extension version pinned in the system-tests workflow (GitHub releases)
Track the Polarion Docker image pinned in the system-tests workflow (JFrog Docker registry; YYMM-N tag scheme)

packageRules.description: Merge the system-test version bumps straight from the branch without opening a PR (includes majors and SNAPSHOTs). Scoped to system-tests.yml so the inherited preset's custom.regex manager (e.g. python-sbb-polarion in pyproject.toml) keeps its normal flow
